# Project knowledge acceptance inputs

These are fictional, deliberately conflicting project histories. They are not evidence that Parcel, Lantern or BuildLore has passed a real verification.

The R1/R2 files and oracle must be frozen before authoring Wiki proposals. Writers and answer readers must not receive oracle.json. A separate reviewer checks the oracle against original inputs and later judges actual answers. Replayed proposals are regression fixtures, not new AI evaluation runs.

P2A history is optional input for Lantern; neither the generic Parcel sample nor the core knowledge schema requires Plan2Agent vocabulary.
